text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-saaan! How about having lunch at 
the plaza? All the classmates were just 
talking about it!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I would love to join you, 
but I've had a string of races lately.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take a nap so that I can 
handle afternoon training.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for inviting me, but... 
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah doesn't seem to have recovered 
from her fatigue. It will be necessary to 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
